Based on the screenshot of the YouTube "Watch later" playlist page, here is the detailed description:

**1. Left Header Panel (Playlist Info)**
*   **Playlist Title:** Large, bold white text reading **"Watch later"**.
*   **Metadata:** Below the title, it shows the channel name (**Spartacus**), the video count (**99 videos**), view status (**No views**), and a timestamp (**Last updated on Sep 16, 2026**).
*   **Action Buttons:** Two prominent pill-shaped buttons are located at the bottom of this panel:
    *   **Play all:** A white button with black text.
    *   **Shuffle:** A dark grey button with white text.
*   *(Note: There is no visible Share or Sort menu in this specific left panel layout).*

**2. Rows List (Video Item Anatomy)**
Each video row in the main content area consists of:
*   **Thumbnail Area (Left):** A large rectangular placeholder (appears light grey/white in this specific UI state).
*   **Text Content (Right):**
    *   **Title:** The video title in bold black text (e.g., "Shay - Thibaut Courtois").
    *   **Metadata Line:** Smaller grey text below the title containing the **Channel Name**, **View Count** (e.g., 17M), and **Time posted** (e.g., 9y ago).
*   *(Note: Index numbers and duration badges are not visible in this specific list view).*

**3. Number of Rows Rendered**
There are **5 fully or partially visible video rows** rendered in the list:
1.  Shay - Thibaut Courtois
2.  Super Mario Odyssey - Nintendo Switch Presentation 2017 Trailer
3.  Tekno - Pana (Official Music Video)
4.  Using Firestore as a backend to your Flutter app
5.  Controlling Data Access Using Firebase Auth Custom Claims (Firecasts)
*(A 6th row is partially visible at the very bottom).*

**4. Sort/Control Row Above the List**
Yes, there is a control bar situated between the header and the video list:
*   **Filter Tabs:** A horizontal row of filter chips including **"Manual"**, **"All"** (which is currently selected/highlighted in black), **"Videos"**, and **"Shorts"**.
*   **Search/Sort Bar:** Directly below the tabs is a long, light-grey rectangular input field or placeholder bar, likely for searching within the playlist or additional sorting options.
